name: RSI dip in an uptrend
description: Buy short-term weakness, but only while the long-term trend is up.

about.how_it_works: RSI falling below 30 means the last couple of weeks of bars were mostly down, so the market is stretched. Buying that dip only when price is above its 200-bar average avoids catching a falling knife in a downtrend. It takes profit when RSI recovers.
about.fails_when: The trend turns: dips keep getting deeper and the stop is hit repeatedly. Also on news-driven crashes, where oversold becomes more oversold.
